music_check.name: Music check
music_check.desc: Checks the audio of a clip: loudness for Reels/Shorts/TikTok and, optionally, which song is playing.
music_check.help: Measures loudness (LUFS) and peak level and compares them with the -14 LUFS that the platforms normalise to. If the clip is too quiet or too loud, a corrected copy can be saved as <name>.loudnorm.mp4 (video is copied unchanged). Optional: identify the music via AcoustID to spot copyrighted songs before upload. That step sends an audio fingerprint (not the audio) to acoustid.org and needs fpcalc (pkg install chromaprint) plus a free API key from acoustid.org, set as AIO_ACOUSTID_KEY or as "acoustid_key" in ~/.aio/config.json. Needs ffmpeg.
music_check.no_audio: This file has no audio track.
music_check.multiple_tracks: Note: {count} audio tracks found, only the first one is checked.
music_check.too_quiet: Too quiet: the platform will turn it up, which can add noise.
music_check.too_loud: Too loud: the platform will turn it down; it may sound squashed.
music_check.peak_high: Peak above -1 dBTP: risk of distortion after conversion.
music_check.identify_hint: Tip: music identification is available with an AcoustID key (see help).
music_check.ask_identify: Identify the music online via AcoustID?
music_check.copyright_note: Copyrighted music can get your clip muted or blocked. Use music from the platform's own library or royalty-free music.
